image_prompt: Pat is a figure of indistinct gender, appearing as a floating, amorphous entity of wavering, translucent form. Their features are obscure, shifting and blending, as if glimpsed through a veil of mist or water. Wispy tendrils of what could be hair or fabric drift and curl around their head and shoulders, lending an ethereal, otherworldly quality. Pat's expression is inscrutable, their face a kaleidoscope of fleeting expressions, from benevolent to unsettling. Their attire, if they can be said to have any, is an ever-changing cascade of textures and patterns, hinting at Victorian-inspired fashions but defying clear definition. This is a being of mystery and ambiguity, both captivating and unnerving to behold.
